services.desc: Gym-Ken Gymnastics offers several types of classes on a year-round basis for children of all ages. Our highly skilled coaches provide a fun, focused and safe environment where children are encouraged to keep progressing and reaching new milestones all at their own pace. The idea behind Parkour is to adapt to an environment. This could be concrete walls, benches, picnic tables, boulders, staircases, playgrounds, etc. At Gym-Ken we will be using mats, trampolines, & climbing walls to create a safe learning environment.
